wlc.edition: Repository WLC/OSHB Genesis and current POB

chapter_manifest.algorithm: SHA256 of compact JSON (sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) of path/sha256 objects for sorted *.yaml paths

sp_tf2024.edition: Moshe Florentin and Abraham Tal, The Samaritan Pentateuch (2024)
sp_tf2024.basis: MS no. 6 (C), not the CBL751-based digital dataset
sp_tf2024.rights: CC BY-NC 4.0; source PDF not redistributed
sp_tf2024.scope: Selected consonantal edition; no full Samaritan manuscript census or fresh manuscript transcription

greek_swete.edition: H. B. Swete, The Old Testament in Greek, I, fourth edition 1909, reprinted 1925
greek_swete.basis: Alexandrinus-based selected text at this locus, including editorial treatment of corrections
greek_swete.scope: Selected main-text numerals, not unanimous Greek testimony

greek_rh2006.inspection: Complete chapter read in public browser; selected text, not full critical apparatus
greek_rh2006.rights: Copyright Deutsche Bibelgesellschaft; numerical facts only, no chapter reproduction

greek_apparatus_control.edition: Brooke and McLean, The Old Testament in Greek, I.1 Genesis (1906)
greek_apparatus_control.finding: 5:25 reports 167 for A* with videtur qualification and correction over erasure behind selected 187; 5:26 records 802/782 variation. Other numeral variants also present.
greek_apparatus_control.independence: Reuses Swete main text; Swete fourth-edition notes also corrected from larger Cambridge edition. Not additional manuscript votes.
greek_apparatus_control.scope: Printed main text and apparatus inspected; no new reading of erased manuscript ink or exhaustive modern apparatus collation

qumran_control.edition: Qumran-Digital 2026-05-21; DFG project 465277421, based on earlier Qumran-Worterbuch/Abegg text
qumran_control.finding: Kenan name precedes supply bracket; final nun marked doubtful. All age wording lies inside bracket. Parallel MT/SP rows are not Qumran ink.

derived_checks.sum_interpretation: Conditional years to Noah birth if genealogy is read as a continuous sequence; not historical dates or Flood dates

independent_check.scope: Nine Samaritan triads and edition methodology/notation, independently inspected rendered pages
independent_check.consistency_followup: Report/table/JSON agreement, conditional sums and evidence boundaries checked; four tests passed

limits: Published readings, not new discovery or decipherment
Selected editions are not a complete all-witness comparison
Arithmetic consistency does not establish priority, authorial intention, or historical chronology
No canonical source, English, footnote, or review metadata changed
ImageGen is not evidence for absent letters or numerals
